name: KC Gonzalez
reason: Not a health-rule case, so the new rule does not change it: the owner dropped her on 31 Oct 2026 because her work is mainly nutrition, and her own site (nouveauhippieholistics.com, re-read 12 Nov 2026) still presents her first as a 'Holistic Nutritional Wellness Consultant' (page title 'Holistic Nutrition'), with yoga and Reiki as secondary services. Diet and nutrition programmes stay out, and the owner's drop stands. Her Wix photos would also be refused by the ingest; the earlier plan's service-page URLs had been found by probing a URL pattern, which the brief no longer allows. Owner may revive a yoga/Reiki-only listing if wanted (plan kept in insight-timer-sprint-1/dropped/).
